title: Easy Linear Programming
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

We have $A$ cards, each of which has an integer $1$ written on it. Similarly, we also have $B$ cards with $0$s and $C$ cards with $-1$s.

We will pick up $K$ among these cards. What is the maximum possible sum of the numbers written on the cards chosen?

## Constraints

- All values in input are integers.
- $0 \leq A, B, C$
- $1 \leq K \leq A + B + C \leq 2 \times 10^9$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
A B C K
```

## Output

Print the maximum possible sum of the numbers written on the cards chosen.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有 $A$ 张卡片，每张卡片上都写着整数 $1$。同样地，还有 $B$ 张写着 $0$ 的卡片，以及 $C$ 张写着 $-1$ 的卡片。

我们将从这些卡片中选出 $K$ 张。选出的卡片上所写数字之和的最大值是多少？

## 约束条件

- 输入中的所有值均为整数。
- $0 \leq A, B, C$
- $1 \leq K \leq A + B + C \leq 2 \times 10^9$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
A B C K
```

## 输出格式

输出选出的卡片上所写数字之和的最大值。

samples.note: Consider picking up two cards with $1$s and one card with a $0$. In this case, the sum of the numbers written on the cards is $2$, which is the maximum possible value.
